_about: 1-Butanol (1) + n-Nonane (2): total pressures against temperature, 323.15-371.15 K, at set liquid compositions. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 1-butanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record.

source.citation: S. Ahmad, R. Giesen, K. Lucas, Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium Studies for Systems Containing n-Butylisocyanate at Temperatures between 323.15 K and 371.15 K, J. Chem. Eng. Data 49 (2004) 826-831
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 5. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. No isotherm of the set has its own pure-component pressures, so the fit uses the vapour pressures of the component records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
